data.name: Lutaif
data.gender_notes: Lutaif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'l-t-f' which means rain. The name Lutaif is associated with the gentle and refreshing sensation of rain. The name Lutaif carries the meaning “Rain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lutaif usually hope their child will grow to embody rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the refreshing blessings of Allah SWT.
data.etymology: Lutaif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lutaif total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: لُطَيْف
in_arabic.meaning: لطيف الخَلق والخُلق، جميل، ناعم، رفيق
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من لطف، يدل على جمال الخَلق والخُلق، ويعبر عن الرفيق الحسن، اللطيف في تعامله مع الآخرين، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلَطِيفٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ'، ويحمل الاسم دلالات روحية عميقة تتعلق بالتعامل الحسن مع الناس

in_urdu.name: لطیف
in_urdu.long_meaning: لطیف نام عربی سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت، ملائم، موزوں، نرم، اور رفیق۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر ہندوستان اور پاکستان میں، کیونکہ یہ اچھے اخلاق اور اچھی صحبت کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: लुतैफ
in_hindi.long_meaning: लुतैफ नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर, सभ्य, स्नेही और मृदुल। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, जो अच्छे चरित्र और अच्छे संबंधों का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: لطيف
in_pashto.long_meaning: لطيف نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوي دي، چې د نرمه، خوږه، او ښه چلند معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دوديزې ارزښتونو سره سم يو مهم نوم ګڼل کيږي

in_english.name: Lutaif
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lutaif originates from the Arabic root 'l-ṭ-f', which means 'gentleness' or 'softness'. It signifies someone with a beautiful character, gentle nature, and kind demeanor. The name is mentioned in the Quran, highlighting the importance of being kind and gentle to believers. Lutaif carries spiritual connotations related to good character and interpersonal relationships

data.cultural_impact: The name Lutaif holds a deep cultural significance in Arabic tradition as it is associated with the beautiful and rejuvenating effects of rain. Rain is a source of life and nourishment for the earth, and provides a sense of renewal and hope. In many Arabic communities, the arrival of rain is celebrated as a divine blessing, and the name Lutaif serves as a reminder of the beauty and power of nature.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Lutaif can be seen as a reminder of God's mercy and kindness towards His creation. Rain is an manifestation of God's sustenance and provision for all living beings. The name Lutaif also carries the essence of the Arabic concept of 'Barakah', which refers to the presence of God's blessings and abundance in all things. Thus, Lutaif serves as a reminder to be grateful for the bounties of God and the beauty of His creation.
